name: btor2-ic3
notes: IC3/PDR over delta-encoded clause frames on one incremental CDCL solver: bad cubes at the frontier are blocked recursively, generalized by literal dropping under an initiation check, and propagated forward after each frontier extension; an empty delta frame is convergence, and the union of the clauses above it — an inductive invariant the machine itself cannot escape — is written as a {"schema": "clauses"} certificate on the all(inf) answer, discharged by btor2@3's judge at the stop. Oversized transition cones are declined up front. Otherwise bounded model checking: a self-replayed witness, a bounded all(k) merged with the frontier IC3 reached, or an honest partial. Budgets derive from the wall argument, never the clock. Era-6 revision 1 = the Era-5 btor2-ic3 text re-cut with the v6 certificate envelope. Revision 2 blasts the signed division family (sdiv, srem, smod — the same construction as btor2-bmc: magnitudes through the unsigned divider, signs fixed after) and evaluates it in the self-replay interpreter, and turns every remaining unsupported op into a partial instead of a crash; thirteen svcomp25-mini programs and four hwmcc24-mini programs crashed the first revision on sdiv/srem. Byte-identical on the predecessor corpus.
